provenance.discovery_fact: CryptoHunterAccountAuthority, genuine resolver, and genuine writer are NOT_FOUND; M0.11 durable current-record carrier is FOUND
provenance.rule: Design evidence cannot mint ACCEPTED or AVAILABLE and this artifact does not implement authority.

root_of_trust.question: Who may create the first genuine CryptoHunterAccount?

models.A_installation_bootstrap_root_authority: NOT_VIABLE_ON_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: bootstrap machinery exists, but no canonical contract delegates account admission to it or binds its consumed proof to a first account
models.B_authenticated_product_owner_operator_a: NOT_VIABLE_ON_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: OperatorIdentity is account-scoped/nearby and cannot authorize creation of the account that would establish its own trust scope
models.C_deployment_admin_authority: NOT_VIABLE_ON_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: no canonical deployment administrator identity, credential, admission operation, or durable provenance is assigned account creation
models.D_external_saas_account_service_authorit: NOT_VIABLE_ON_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: CryptoHunterAccount is a SaaS/customer-account candidate, but no external service protocol, issuer key, audience, replay rule, or restart proof exists

accepted_record.reason: An exact admission_provenance_reference and authentication binding cannot be typed or validated before selecting a genuine root actor and durability/authentication authority; freezing placeholders would invent authority.
required_semantics_not_schema: genuine authority-bound account_id whose mint/reservation ownership and provenance satisfy the selected root-of-trust protocol
predecessor/head binding in selected history model

id_minting.accepted_account_record_id_owner: future genuine authority only; exact grammar DESIGN_BLOCKED
frozen_subfacts: candidate/reserved ID is not authority before genesis commit

admission.request_boundary: typed closed CreateCryptoHunterAccount request, never a raw mapping or accepted fact

candidate_request_fields.environment_domain: explicit TEST or PRODUCTION authority domain
candidate_request_fields.correlation_id: optional tracing only; excluded from semantic fingerprint
candidate_request_fields.trusted_actor_proof: required independent proof; exact type DESIGN_BLOCKED

admission.semantic_request_identity: authentication domain + command_id + canonical request fingerprint excluding only correlation_id
admission.authority_output: a typed accepted account fact only after all admission gates commit
admission.trusted_actor_proof: must verify independently of the new account; exact issuer/evidence DESIGN_BLOCKED
admission.account_id_input_rule: Only caller-selected/self-minted genuine identity is forbidden. Whether a future typed request carries an authority-bound account_id or reservation/provenance reference depends on the selected root-of-trust model.

lifecycle.decision: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, CLOSED, REVOKED, and DELETED are not account-identity states absent product semantics; access and usability belong to independently authoritative grants/policies.

effects.new_Workspace_creation: requires genuine current account resolution plus future Workspace policy; genesis alone does not authorize creation
effects.existing_Workspace_usability: unchanged by account lifecycle because none is defined; governed by its own authorities and access grants

resolver_model.resolve_current_account(account_id): returns only a genuine authenticated/fresh authority fact derived from verified authority genesis, or NOT_A_GENUINE_ACCOUNT/AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE; current equals immutable genesis
resolver_model.resolve_account_revision(account_id, gen: resolves the exact immutable accepted genesis at its authority-global admission generation, or NOT_FOUND; no mutable per-account revision exists

evaluated.B_immutable_genesis_plus_lifecycle_journ: rejected because no lifecycle semantics are established
evaluated.C_current_plus_external_history: rejected; ambiguous and insufficient for historical parent proof

history_model.model: immutable authenticated append-only authority-global admission journal; one immutable genesis per account; no account revisions after genesis
history_model.historical_retention: indefinite for every account referenced by persistent descendants
history_model.deletion: no authority-record deletion or ID reuse

durability_model.source_of_genuine_facts: future authenticated append-only account admission journal plus authenticated head and external non-rollbackable freshness anchor
durability_model.current_index: derived from verified genesis facts and never authoritative alone

m011_carrier_integration.direction: CryptoHunterAccountAuthority -> genuine accepted/current fact -> projection adapter -> M0.11 CryptoHunterAccount current record
m011_carrier_integration.reconciliation_invariant: Within every M0.11 StateStore contractually designated as a projection target for account X, the CryptoHunterAccount current record must exactly equal the deterministic PersistentEntityIdentityProjection(entity_kind=CryptoHunterAccount, entity_id=X, parent_scope_bindings={}); within a StateStore scoped to acct_A no CryptoHunterAccount row for acct_B may exist. This local invariant does not assert discovery of all device stores.
m011_carrier_integration.mismatch_on_restart: For a contractually designated target whose gating role is frozen, DENY that target/gate or repair only from already verified authority facts; never choose a newer local timestamp, let M0.11 win, or infer a global all-replica gate.

immutable_StateStore_identity.transition_invariant: all fields remain equal across G -> G+1 or commit fails with immutable store identity changed

environment.mutability_claim: NONE: exclusion from _IDENTITY_FIELDS does not by itself prove environment is mutable

projection_target_partitioning.proven_cardinality: one CryptoHunterAccount may have multiple device-scoped/local StateStores because DeviceInstallation is one-to-many and device_installation_id is immutable identity; no environment cardinality is proven

m011_projection_topology.reason: The executable contract proves immutable account/device/fingerprint identity and additional metadata dimensions, but does not select the projection target set, discovery mechanism, gating role, environment partitioning, or multi-device repair policy.

models.A_LOCAL_DEVICE_ONLY: NOT_SELECTED: local scope exists, but no canonical rule makes only the starting device a target or defines publication ordering
models.B_ALL_KNOWN_DEVICE_STORES: NOT_SELECTED: known-device enumeration, offline-device behavior, and synchronous quorum are not defined
models.C_DESIGNATED_PRIMARY_DEVICE_STORE: NOT_SELECTED: no primary-device designation authority or failover contract exists
models.D_PER_ACCOUNT_PER_ENVIRONMENT_PROJECTION: NOT_SELECTED / NOT_PROVEN_BY_CURRENT_IDENTITY_CONTRACT: environment is metadata/protocol state, not an executable immutable identity field
models.E_DERIVED_ASYNCHRONOUS_REPLICA_SET_NOT_R: NOT_SELECTED: compatible with derived-carrier direction, but replica-health/conflict and repair delivery policy lack canonical evidence

multi_device_relation.projection_unit: NOT_FROZEN: per device, per process, or per local installation is not canonically selected; per-environment targeting is only an unproven candidate, not an existing identity partition

authority_resolver_publication_gate.rule: Authority availability must not accidentally mean all derived replicas are healthy. Only targets whose scope and gating role are selected by a future topology may participate in this gate.
authority_resolver_publication_gate.reason_for_false: No ALL_KNOWN_DEVICE_STORES topology or offline-device semantics is selected; this is not permission to publish while silently ignoring conflict.

projection_replica_health.offline_scenario: acct_A genuine; dev_1 current; dev_2 offline/stale -> effect on global resolver NOT_FROZEN
projection_replica_health.online_conflict_scenario: dev_1 current; dev_2 online/stale or conflicting -> MUST NOT be silently ignored; repairable-replica versus security-failure classification NOT_FROZEN

projection_repair_permission.source: already verified genuine CryptoHunterAccount authority facts only
projection_repair_permission.scope: DESIGN_BLOCKED: local-only, all reachable replicas, or queued asynchronous repair is not selected

authority_domain_to_StateStore_environme.rule: No target is eligible through an inferred mapping: environment is metadata/protocol state, and the current contract proves neither a Store-identity partition nor an account-authority-domain mapping.

m011_projection_topology.local_extra_row_invariant: Within metadata scoped to acct_A, every CryptoHunterAccount current record entity_id must equal StateStoreMetadata.account_id == acct_A; acct_B is rejected locally.
m011_projection_topology.global_inventory_claim: FORBIDDEN: the local invariant does not prove the authority knows every M0.11 row on every device

authentication.required_model: keyed authenticated canonical authority records, predecessor/head, domain and generation; HMAC-SHA-256 is a repository-established candidate, not selected without a key owner
authentication.authentication_domain: must bind product, CryptoHunterAccountAuthority schema/version, environment domain, store identity, record/head kind, generation, predecessor and canonical content
authentication.key_rotation: must retain verification of all historical records and atomically authenticate successor-key activation; exact protocol NOT_FROZEN
authentication.recovery: only independently authenticated recovery authority may re-establish key access; exact authority NOT_FOUND
authentication.lost_key: FAIL_CLOSED; no account reconstruction from local records or M0.11

freshness.required: external non-rollbackable monotonic anchor exact-bound to environment/store identity, authenticated authority generation and head authenticator

rollback.coherent_rewrite: MUST_FAIL authentication and/or external freshness equality even if journal, head, hashes, and M0.11 projection agree

sequence: open only environment-specific authority storage and keep resolver unavailable
verify storage/schema and reject incomplete prepared/finalized state
verify every record/head keyed authenticator and authentication domain
verify complete generation sequence, predecessor closure, unique genesis/account IDs, idempotency index closure, and exact current head
require external freshness anchor equality with authenticated head; reject older/newer/incomparable values
resolve and verify root actor provenance independently for every admission; no account may establish its own actor
derive genuine current accounts only from verified immutable genesis facts
verify/reconcile only M0.11 projection targets whose scope and publication-gating role are frozen by the selected topology; topology is currently blocked
publish resolver only after all checks succeed
restart.M011_reconciliation_portion: DESIGN_BLOCKED until projection target set and gating role are selected
restart.missing_local_projection_after_verified_: repair from verified authority; never downgrade or erase genuine genesis; whether publication waits for repair is DESIGN_BLOCKED

restore.restored_projection_status: UNTRUSTED until revalidated against recoverable genuine authority

crash_atomicity.rule: authority commit is serialized prepare -> authenticated record/idempotency result -> authenticated head -> external anchor CAS -> finalized marker; M0.11 projections follow and may lag independently per future topology

points.before_prepare: no effect; old verified head remains
points.after_prepare: intent is non-current; abort/recover using authenticated old head
points.after_authority_record: record is non-current and must not resolve until head+anchor finalize
points.after_authority_head: if anchor is old, resolver remains unavailable; complete exact pending CAS or fail closed
points.after_freshness_anchor: anchor is authoritative freshness; recovery must find exact authenticated local head/result or fail closed—never roll anchor back
points.before_M011_projection_update: authority is committed; missing/lagging local projection must be repaired from verified authority and must not make the account non-genuine; whether resolver publication waits for that designated local repair is DESIGN_BLOCKED
points.after_M011_projection_update: verify equality and finalize projection bookkeeping; projection never proves commit

crash_atomicity.unknown_external_anchor_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED pending authoritative read/compare; never blind retry with a new account ID
crash_atomicity.committed_genesis_invariant: A lagging or missing derived projection alone MUST NOT retroactively invalidate an already committed genuine authority genesis; only an explicitly selected future topology may make specified projection health a publication gate.
crash_atomicity.multi_device_attack: dev_1 updated and dev_2 stale/offline creates no implicit synchronous global requirement; resolver effect and replica repair/health outcome remain DESIGN_BLOCKED with topology

concurrency.CAS: every mutation supplies expected authenticated head generation+authenticator; commit is exactly G to G+1
concurrency.exact_duplicate: returns the durably retained original accepted genesis/account_id and creates no record
concurrency.conflicting_duplicate: same environment+command_id with different canonical request fingerprint => REPLAY_CONFLICT and no mutation
concurrency.concurrent_distinct: one CAS winner; loser retries from new verified head using its same request identity

idempotency.key_owner: caller mints command_id; authority validates idempotency_key == command_id and owns durable interpretation/result
idempotency.request_fingerprint: canonical closed request excluding only correlation_id; includes causation_id, environment and actor-proof reference/binding
idempotency.retention: indefinite, co-retained with immutable admission journal and freshness-protected; no key reuse
idempotency.exact_retry: same result including same account_id and accepted genesis
idempotency.conflict: REPLAY_CONFLICT; never mint second ID or genesis

environment_isolation.production_test_storage: physically/logically distinct store identities and paths
environment_isolation.key_material: distinct; no shared active or recovery keys

workspace_parent_binding.admission_requirement: future WorkspaceAuthority must consume genuine resolved CryptoHunterAccount authority fact
workspace_parent_binding.historical_resolution: pins account_id and genuine immutable account genesis; later access-policy changes cannot reparent or erase historical binding

self_mint_resistance.scenario: caller has valid acct_<uuidv7>, accepted-record-looking mapping, correct public fingerprint, and valid M0.11 projection, but no genuine independent root actor proof

nearby_entity_boundary.rule: Account may be referenced as scope by separately authoritative entities; this authority neither mints nor mutates them.
